shortDescription: Australian logistics software provider WiseTech Global ASX:WTC said on Tuesday it has appointed Jeff Howard as its chief financial officer, effective September 28.Here are some further details.

children: Australian logistics software provider WiseTech Global
said on Tuesday it has appointed Jeff Howard as its chief financial officer, effective September 28.

Prior to joining WiseTech, Jeff Howard has been CFO and subsequently managing director and CEO of Seven West Media, before leading the combined group following its merger with Southern Cross Media Group
Caroline Pham, who has been interim CFO since October 2024, will remain with the company to help support the transition, WiseTech said in its statement.

"The global scale of CargoWise, the e2open acquisition, the benefits from WiseTech's rapid adoption of AI, and the growth opportunities set out in the FY26 results presentation together make this an exciting time to join WiseTech," Howard said.
